items.title: Solventum (NYSE:SOLV) beats Q3 2026 sales expectations
items.summary: Healthcare solutions provider Solventum (NYSE:SOLV) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, but revenue fell by 7% year on year to $1.95 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.45 per share was 7.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
